## Publication and remaining holds

What is independently certified versus merely source-linked or technically tested? Name remaining donor, doctrinal, French, copyright, geolocation or liturgical gaps explicitly. No "certified" based on author attestations alone.

## Close-out

After merge: link merge SHA in the canonical issue, give any superseded PR a disposition, and allow safe automatic removal of the merged head. Do not delete research-only unmerged history.
